faq.question: Where is THE BARLI?

faq.question: How do I book a stay?
faq.answer: Contact our bookings team on +234 916 700 0099 by phone or WhatsApp to confirm availability and current rates.

faq.question: What rooms can I enquire about?
faq.answer: Ask our team about the Executive Suite, Prestige Room, Deluxe Room and Comfort Room.

faq.question: What amenities are available?
faq.answer: THE BARLI offers 24 hour power, secure keyless entry and arrival support. Private airport transfers can be arranged on request.
